Conflicts and recovery

Push never overwrites an unseen remote backup. Pull stops if you have unpushed changes. To deliberately take the remote copy, download your current backup first, then replace local records below.

Repository privacy is checked before every transfer. GitHub history keeps earlier photos and notes even after deletion in the app. A private repository is access-controlled, not end-to-end encrypted.
